subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “There is a wall near the school gate where students can put small notes.”?
options: No one knows who writes each note, and that is part of the beauty.
Then the radio team added a new part called "One Good Thing."
Mr. Brown writes some of the answers on colored paper and puts them on the classroom wall.
Then Mina put a small note beside it: "I am thirsty."

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「No one knows who writes each note, and that is part of the beauty.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Then the radio team added a new part called 'One Good Thing.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Mr. Brown writes some of the answers on colored paper and puts them on the classroom wall.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Then Mina put a small note beside it: 'I am thirsty.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「No one knows who writes each note, and that is part of the beauty.」，答案為「No one knows who writes each note, and that is part of the beauty.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「No one knows who writes each note, and that is part of the beauty.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
